create.name: Dr. John Ryan
create.bio:
Dr. John Ryan trained in medicine and spent more than twenty years as a hospital specialist in diagnostic imaging and an associate professor of medicine. A series of inner awakening experiences drew him towards older and newer forms of energy work and the spiritual side of wellbeing, and over two decades he moved from studying these approaches to practising and teaching them. He describes his present work as consciousness-based energy medicine.

He is the founder of Unity Field Healing, a meditative system of three guided attunements built on his visionary account of a 'quantum' or spiritual layer of human DNA, which he sets out in his book Unity Field Healing, Volume 1, published in English, French and Spanish. He trains practitioners in the method, now with a small circle of certified teachers, and offers an online introductory seminar. Since 2019 he has also led monthly online gatherings in which he channels teachings attributed to the Sirian Blue White Collective, combining talks, guided meditation and Light Language in year-long cycles. His YouTube channel carries recordings of these sessions and his New Human Conversations interview series.

flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link (unityfieldhealing.com and drjohnryan.org pages checked).
Only one photo of him could be confirmed (his own 'Dr John Ryan' page); the YouTube avatar is a Unity Field Healing graphic and the drjohnryan.org images are small or abstract.

He is a medical doctor (diagnostic imaging) but the listing covers his energy-medicine and channelled teaching, not clinical work. His YouTube shorts include a few autism-related titles (spiritual readings of autistic children); the channel is not mainly condition-led, but a human may want to look.
Email contact@drjohnryan.org is published as a mailto link on drjohnryan.org (his older site) and also appears on the unityfieldhealing.com contact page.
Channelled teachings (Sirian Blue White Collective) and 'quantum DNA / 24th chromosome' ideas are his own framing; the bio reports them as his account, without endorsing them.
Book ASIN 2896264981 is linked by his own site (drjohnryan.org UFH Vol 1 page and unityfieldhealing.com); ISBN 978-2-89626-498-8 on unityfieldhealing.com, not confirmed elsewhere.
YouTube views on the recent transmission recordings are very low (2-4 each); the three older talks are more watched (about 600-5,800).
